entries.title: Job 11:1
segments: ¶Then Zophar the Naamathite made answer and said,

entries.title: Job 11:2
segments: Are all these words to go unanswered? and is a man seen to be right because he is full of talk?

entries.title: Job 11:3
segments: Are your words of pride to make men keep quiet? and are you to make sport, with no one to put you to shame?

entries.title: Job 11:4
segments: You may say, My way is clean, and I am free from sin in your eyes.

entries.title: Job 11:5
segments: But if only God would take up the word, opening his lips in argument with you;

entries.title: Job 11:6
segments: And would make clear to you the secrets of wisdom, and the wonders of his purpose!

entries.title: Job 11:7
segments: ¶Are you able to take God's measure, to make discovery of the limits of the Ruler of all?

entries.title: Job 11:8
segments: They are higher than heaven; what is there for you to do? deeper than the underworld, and outside your knowledge;

entries.title: Job 11:9
segments: Longer in measure than the earth, and wider than the sea.

entries.title: Job 11:10
segments: If he goes on his way, shutting a man up and putting him to death, who may make him go back from his purpose?

entries.title: Job 11:11
segments: For in his eyes men are as nothing; he sees evil and takes note of it.

entries.title: Job 11:12
segments: And so a hollow-minded man will get wisdom, when a young ass of the field gets teaching.

entries.title: Job 11:13
segments: ¶But if you put your heart right, stretching out your hands to him;

entries.title: Job 11:14
segments: If you put far away the evil of your hands, and let no wrongdoing have a place in your tent;

entries.title: Job 11:15
segments: Then truly your face will be lifted up, with no mark of sin, and you will be fixed in your place without fear:

entries.title: Job 11:16
segments: For your sorrow will go from your memory, like waters flowing away:

entries.title: Job 11:17
segments: And your life will be brighter than day; though it is dark, it will become like the morning.

entries.title: Job 11:18
segments: And you will be safe because there is hope; after looking round, you will take your rest in quiet;

entries.title: Job 11:19
segments: Sleeping with no fear of danger; and men will be desiring to have grace in your eyes;

entries.title: Job 11:20
segments: But the eyes of the evil-doers will be wasting away; their way of flight is gone, and their only hope is the taking of their last breath.
